Data Portability & Privacy-Safe Publishing

Backup, Import & Public Web Export

1. Personal Backup & Restore (JSON / Markdown)

Export your complete reading statuses, ratings, synthesis summaries, Very Important Notes, mental models, and custom books—or restore from a previous JSON backup.

2. Export Public Alexandria Catalogue (`index.html`)

Privacy Safe by Default

Downloads a standalone, ready-to-host index.html containing the entire Alexandria literary & polymath catalogue with all private notes, summaries, ratings, and reading statuses stripped so you can safely publish to GitHub Pages, Netlify, or Cloudflare Pages.

3. Export Catalogue With Personal Library Embedded

Only use this option if you intentionally want to share a personal reading edition that includes your reading statuses, summaries, and notes inside the downloaded HTML file.
